scientific_integrity: All claimed finite enumerations reconstructed from explicit closed neighborhoods, exhaustive candidate ranges, enumerated exchange edges, BFS distance calculations and a second sensor-index-signature/orbit program. Known minimum code size seven not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation pertains only to the four-cube; priority is qualified by incomplete full-text access to the closely related 2015/2016 ensemble paper, and no independent audit was performed.
title: Uniform shortest-path profiles of optimal identifying-code exchanges on the four-cube
